subject: Proposed trial kickoff window & prompt handoff
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novamed.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-05-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up from discovery — trial kickoff windows

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the call this morning — good alignment on where Redwood fits our roadmap. Quick recap and ask so we can lock the next step: we want to schedule the evaluation kickoff (technical deep dive + trial plan) and a separate prompt handoff session.

Key objectives for the kickoff:
- Confirm trial scope (primary use case: clinical note summarization, approx 50k tokens/day)
- Agree success criteria (latency targets and quality thresholds)
- Walk through integration points (S3 ingestion, API auth, data retention)
- Deliver prompt seed set and evaluation harness

Proposed kickoff windows (Novamed local / PT):
- Option A: Tue May 23 — Thu May 25 (we prefer Tue 23rd morning)
- Option B: Tue May 30 — Fri Jun 2 (any day after 2pm PT)

Attendees we expect: product lead, 2 engineers (one infra), security/ops rep. If Redwood can include an engineering lead + solutions architect that would be ideal.

Can you propose a 90–120 minute slot and confirm who from your side will join? Also please share any pre-read or kickoff template so our team can come prepared.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Elena
Elena Ruiz
Head of Product, Novamed
elena.ruiz@novamed.com

Attachment: novamed-discovery-notes.txt (text)
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novamed.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-05-14T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from discovery — trial kickoff windows

Hi Elena — great to connect earlier, thanks for the clear summary.

We can do a combined technical deep dive + kickoff for the trial. Two options that work on our side:
- Tue, May 23 at 10:00 AM PT (90–120m)
- Tue, May 30 at 2:00 PM PT (90–120m)

If May 23 at 10am PT works for you, I’ll send a calendar hold and draft agenda. Otherwise I’ll lock May 30.

Pre-work we’ll share:
- Trial charter draft (attached) — outlines roles, milestones, and success metrics
- Prompt sample CSV (attached) — recommended seed prompts and expected labels
- Short runbook link for the deep dive (I’ll add to the calendar invite)

For the kickoff agenda I propose:
1) Introductions & success criteria alignment (15m)
2) Trial scope & timeline (15m)
3) Technical deep dive: infra, auth, data flows (40m)
4) Prompt handoff & evaluation plan (20–30m)

Can you confirm attendees and whether Novamed prefers SSO or API key for initial testing? Also flag any security questions up front so we can have our security engineer on the call if needed.

I’ve CCed Marissa (solutions) and Ben (platform) so they’re looped for the deep dive.

– Olga
Olga Petrov
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

Attachments: trial-charter-draft.pdf (application/pdf); prompt-sample.csv (text/csv)

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novamed.com>

Cc: Samir Shah <s.s@novamed.com>, Priya Kapoor <p.kapoor@novamed.com>
Date: 2028-05-15T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from discovery — trial kickoff windows

Olga — May 23 at 10:00 AM PT works for our team, please send the invite.

Attendees confirmed:
- Elena Ruiz (product)
- Samir Shah — Engineering Lead (s.s@novamed.com)
- Priya Kapoor — Data/ML Engineer (p.kapoor@novamed.com)
- Asha Menon — Security (asha.m@novamed.com) — may join for ~30m

High-level success criteria we want to track during the trial:
- Latency: median < 120ms, p99 < 300ms for 512-token requests
- Quality: extractive accuracy / F1 target >= 0.86 on seed prompt set
- Throughput: sustain 40 qps with 95th pctile under 500ms on our representative load
- Integration: sample S3 ingestion + API ingestion working end-to-end

We’ve attached a short security questionnaire and a csv of 200 priority prompts we plan to hand off on the kickoff.

We prefer a 2-hour kickoff so we can demo the integration and walk through prompts together.

Thanks — Samir will send a calendar invite from our side if you prefer, otherwise please send from Redwood and include the Drive folder link.

Elena

Attachment: novamed-security-answers.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>

Date: 2028-05-16T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from discovery — trial kickoff windows

Perfect — thanks for the quick confirmation and the prompt pack. I’ve created a 2-hour calendar hold for Tue, May 23 10:00–12:00 PT and invited the attendees listed. Calendar invite includes:
- Draft agenda (same as earlier)
- Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c (I uploaded the trial-charter-draft and prompt-sample)
- Pre-work: please add the 200 prompts to the shared csv if you have any additional labels, and send any SSO/IDP details (if using SAML) so our infra team can prep.

Pre-kickoff owners:
- Redwood (Olga/Marissa/Ben): finalize trial charter, prepare evaluation harness, stand up temporary API keys for the test environment
- Novamed (Samir/Priya): provide sample S3 bucket + ingestion manifest, confirm security questionnaire answers, share any availability constraints for follow-up sessions

We’ll run a quick internal run of the prompt pack on Monday and share a short pre-read with initial signal metrics before the call. If there are specific edge cases you want prioritized during the deep dive, reply-all and flag them so we can include them in the run.

Looking forward — calendar invite sent.

Cheers,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
